record.title: Evaluate sampled response and a useful bounded measurement control
record.intent: Determine what current-policy physical response was observed and the smallest next comparison.
requirements: Reduce sealed records with fixed fundamental-fit bands centered on the command frequency plus/minus1e-4, grid at most5kHz and existing edge/boundary/competing controls. Retain command, builtin readback, raw FFT bin and fitted frequency separately; do not widen bands after seeing results.

Report all repeats or missing/censored points, unnormalized100MHz anchors, engineering0.3dB return criterion, dispersion, residuals, extrema and fixedorder1through9 alias/rank diagnostics. Keep omitted folded energy, source/cable response and scope-clock uncertainty explicit.

Claim only apparent sampled whole-chain response. Keep calibrated absolute bandwidth and matched software-policy effect gates open. Evaluate whether a separate fixed-frequency OFF-to250M-toOFF ordinary channel-limiter control would materially verify reversible measurement sensitivity.
Admit only a justified bounded successor within remaining authority/time; commit/push conclusions and leave a clean checkpoint by the three-hour deadline.
acceptance: A reproducible sampled-response finding and an evidence-based next comparison follow from the complete retained dataset or exact failure.
